info.title: Intraface HTTP API
info.description:
Every route the Intraface app serves. Errors share one envelope: `{ error: { code, message, hint?, details? } }`.

## Error codes

| Code | HTTP status |
|---|---|
| `bad_request` | 400 |
| `unauthorized` | 401 |
| `forbidden` | 403 |
| `not_found` | 404 |
| `conflict` | 409 |
| `needs_rebase` | 409 |
| `too_large` | 413 |
| `missing_blob` | 422 |
| `missing_asset` | 422 |
| `external_media` | 422 |
| `bad_manifest` | 422 |
| `too_many_new_blobs` | 422 |
| `bad_base` | 400 |
| `rate_limited` | 429 |
| `retry` | 503 |
| `not_implemented` | 501 |
| `upgrade_required` | 426 |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 |
| `authorization_pending` | 400 |
| `slow_down` | 400 |
| `expired_token` | 400 |
| `access_denied` | 400 |
| `taken_down` | 451 |
| `blocked_content` | 422 |
| `internal` | 500 |
